backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access control, user profiles, and an approval workflow with admin‑gated actions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented frontend changes, associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Index of concise summaries describing purpose and behavior of numerous frontend source files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook detailing build steps, approval gating verification, rollback, and troubleshooting.
frontend/firestore.rules: Firestore security rules enforcing role‑based access for users, admins, and super_admins with strict update permissions.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH‑based color tokens and light/dark theme variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting the title to Saddam Chat and initializing Firebase via CDN-loaded scripts.
frontend/LIVE_SMOKE_TEST.md: Live smoke test checklist covering signup, login, approval gating, redirects, and missing‑profile handling.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component managing client-side routing, authentication checks, and rendering screens with a QueryClient provider.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserRowAct: Renders admin actions for a user row, including approve, block, role changes, and delete with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Blocks access to children unless the user has an admin or super admin role, showing a loading spinner during profile fetch.
frontend/src/components/auth/Authenticat: Ensures a user is authenticated and has a loaded profile before rendering children, otherwise redirects via callback.
Provides a centered auth page layout with footer branding for login-related screens.
frontend/src/components/auth/SuperAdminR: Restricts access to super admin users, handling loading and unauthorized states.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Top navigation header showing the app logo and user menu based on the loaded user profile.
frontend/src/components/layout/ProfileMe: User dropdown menu providing profile navigation, admin shortcuts, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirebaseAuthUser.t: Loads Firebase auth dynamically and listens for auth state changes, exposing the current user and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUserProfi: Fetches the current user's Firestore profile using react-query once authentication is established.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUsersList: Provides queries and mutations for listing, approving, updating roles, and deleting user profiles from Firestore.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, handling login state, loading saved identities, and offering login/clear functions.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes, applying global typography and color rules.
frontend/src/lib/firebase.ts: Wraps CDN-loaded Firebase, providing helpers for auth, Firestore access, user profile creation, and first-user detection.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseErrorMessages.t: Maps Firebase auth and Firestore error codes to human‑readable messages.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for user profiles and signup data.
frontend/src/lib/postLoginRedirect.ts: Computes the correct post-login route based on user role and approval status.
Resizes and compresses profile images to JPEG, validates size, and returns processed file metadata.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function that merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminChatsScr: Admin-protected screen that shows a placeholder for upcoming chat management features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminDashboar: Displays admin-only dashboard stats on total, approved, pending, and admin users using Firestore data.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminLayout.t: Defines the admin layout with sidebar navigation, mobile sheet menu, and main content area, highlighting active routes and handling navigation callbacks.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsS: Renders the admin Reports page behind an admin guard, showing placeholder cards indicating upcoming reporting features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminSettings: Displays the admin Settings page behind an admin guard with a placeholder card for future configuration features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminUsersScr: Shows a user management table with profiles, roles, statuses, and actions, using Firestore hooks and the admin layout.
frontend/src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx: Renders a placeholder chat UI indicating real‑time messaging is under development.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Displays the home dashboard using the user's Firestore profile, offering quick links and a footer.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Handles email/password login, fetches user profile, and determines redirect routes with error handling.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: Provides a UI-only password reset request form and displays a confirmation message without backend integration.
frontend/src/screens/PendingApprovalScre: Shows a pending-approval notice with next steps and a link back to login for users awaiting admin approval.
frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx: Loads and displays the logged-in user's profile details, including avatar, name, email, and role.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: Implements user signup with form validation, profile photo upload or camera capture, and Firebase signup handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, colors, animations, plugins, and content scanning settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata including requirements, known issues, routing rules, and feature-tracking state.
